definitions.explanation: A long pole used for catching fish, typically with a line, reel, and hook attached.

examples.japanese: ⟦カーボン→カーボン：10843_kaabon⟧⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a carbon fiber fishing rod.
I went to the river with my fishing rod.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}{向|む}け→初心者向け：17934_shoshinshamuke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are fishing rod sets for beginners.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{釣|つ}り→釣り：03439_tsuri⟧ (fishing) + ⟦{竿|さお}→竿：24133_sao⟧ (pole) → {釣|つ}り{竿|ざお} (rendaku: さお → ざお)

TYPES:
- のべ{竿|ざお}: fixed rod without reel (traditional style)
- リール{竿|ざお}: rod with reel
- {投|な}げ{竿|ざお}: casting rod (for surf fishing)
- ルアーロッド: lure fishing rod

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}る→振る：01983_furu⟧: to cast a fishing rod
- {釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧しまう: to put away a fishing rod
- {釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧: to set up a fishing rod

USAGE:
Also written as {釣竿|つりざお} without the okurigana. The English loanword ロッド is also common, especially for modern-style rods.
